agent_execution_completed.title: AI run complete
agent_execution_completed.message: The AI run for "{taskTitle}" is complete

auth_failure.title: Claude authentication expired
auth_failure.message: Auto-run agents cannot start because the Claude CLI authentication expired. Run `claude login` in the integrated terminal to re-authenticate. Blocked tasks will retry automatically once you do.

intake_question_pending.title: A clarifying question is waiting for an answer
intake_question_pending.message: Task #{taskId} "{taskTitle}" will not proceed until the clarifying question is answered. Open the notification to answer.

question_auto_answered.title: Auto-adopted the recommended answer
question_auto_answered.message: Auto-adopted the recommendation '{recommendedLabel}' for task "{taskTitle}"'s question ({elapsedMinutes} min unanswered). Correct the criteria and re-run if you want a different answer.

auto_run_awaiting_approval.title: Auto-run: waiting for plan approval
auto_run_awaiting_approval.message: The implementation plan for "{taskLabel}" is waiting for approval. Auto-run is paused until it is approved.

auto_run_awaiting_answer.title: Auto-run: agent is waiting for an answer
auto_run_awaiting_answer.message: The agent working on "{taskLabel}" is waiting for an answer to its question. Auto-run for this theme stays paused until it is answered.

auto_run_hang_backstop.title: Auto-run: task stopped at the time limit
auto_run_hang_backstop.message: Task #{taskId} "{taskLabel}" was stopped after exceeding its time limit ({wallMinutes} min). If auto-run is enabled for this theme, it will retry automatically within a few minutes as long as retry attempts remain (up to {maxBlockedRetry} times). Retrying manually right now consumes one of those automatic attempts — unless it's urgent, just check the logs and let the automatic retry happen.

auto_run_task_skipped.title: Auto-run: task skipped
auto_run_task_skipped.message: "{taskLabel}" was skipped because it failed or was blocked: {reason}

auto_run_task_vanished.title: Auto-run: task not found
auto_run_task_vanished.message: Task #{taskId}'s row could not be found, so auto-run skipped it and moved on.

auto_run_all_blocked.title: Auto-run: every runnable task is blocked
auto_run_all_blocked.message: Theme "{themeName}" is wedged, not done: {blockedCount} blocked task(s) remain ({escalatedCount} already escalated). Human action (answer, split, or investigate) is needed.

auto_run_stall_released.title: Auto-run: released a stalled queue item
auto_run_stall_released.message: Released {releasedCount} leftover queue item(s) for task #{taskId} "{taskLabel}" (reason: {cause}). Auto-run continues to the next task.

auto_run_queue_starved.title: Auto-run: the queue is not draining
auto_run_queue_starved.message: 0 running tasks while the queue sat unconsumed for about {waitedMinutes} min{taskRef}. Restarted the workflow runner to resume consumption.

auto_run_zero_progress.title: Auto-run: no progress (possible spin loop)
auto_run_zero_progress.message: The theme keeps reporting running, but task #{taskId} "{taskLabel}" has produced zero executions (AgentExecution) for {elapsedMinutes} min. This may be an enqueue/cancel spin loop.

auto_run_resource_hold.title: Auto-run: held off starting the next task (resource pressure)
auto_run_resource_hold.message: Held off starting the next task for theme "{themeName}" for one cycle (host-wide CPU busy {cpuBusyPercent}% exceeded the {thresholdPercent}% threshold). Will re-evaluate next scheduler tick — you can also start it now from the dashboard.

auto_run_all_done.title: Auto-run: all tasks complete
auto_run_all_done.message: All target tasks for theme "{themeName}" are processed. Auto-run is finishing.

auto_run_idle_stopped.title: Auto-run: stopped — no new tasks were filed
auto_run_idle_stopped.message: Theme "{themeName}" ran out of tasks and nothing new was filed, so auto-run was stopped. It can resume once you file a task manually or the nightly self-refill window opens.

blocked_escalation.title: A blocked task needs attention
blocked_escalation.message: #{taskId} "{taskTitle}" is excluded from automatic retry (reason: {reason}). {reason, select, awaiting_question {An answer is required — this task will not resume until it is answered.} verify_repair_exhausted {The verification-repair budget is exhausted — the task needs to be split.} verify_no_convergence {Rejections are not converging (the same acceptance criteria keep failing) — split the task or revisit the spec.} retry_cap_exhausted {The automatic retry limit was reached — manual investigation is needed.} pr_recovery_exhausted {Automatic PR-creation recovery (light retry) repeatedly failed to create a PR — check the GitHub integration, permissions, and repository state manually.} abandoned_old {This has been idle for a long time (outside the auto-retry window) — manual investigation is needed.} other {}}{detail}

blocked_escalation_reescalated.title: A blocked task still needs attention (continued)
blocked_escalation_reescalated.message: #{taskId} "{taskTitle}" is still unresolved {hours} hours after escalation (reason: {reason}). {reason, select, awaiting_question {An answer is required — this task will not resume until it is answered.} verify_repair_exhausted {The verification-repair budget is exhausted — the task needs to be split.} verify_no_convergence {Rejections are not converging (the same acceptance criteria keep failing) — split the task or revisit the spec.} retry_cap_exhausted {The automatic retry limit was reached — manual investigation is needed.} pr_recovery_exhausted {Automatic PR-creation recovery (light retry) repeatedly failed to create a PR — check the GitHub integration, permissions, and repository state manually.} abandoned_old {This has been idle for a long time (outside the auto-retry window) — manual investigation is needed.} other {}}

auto_pr_created.title: Auto PR creation complete
auto_pr_created.message: Automatically created a PR for task "{taskTitle}": {prUrl}

auto_pr_merged.title: Auto merge complete
auto_pr_merged.message: Automatically merged the PR for task "{taskTitle}" ({mergeStrategy})

auto_pr_merge_failed.title: Auto merge failed
auto_pr_merge_failed.message: Automatic merge of the PR for task "{taskTitle}" failed: {error}

auto_merge_ci_repair_no_diff.title: Auto merge held (repair produced no diff)

auto_merge_ci_failed.title: Auto merge held (CI failed, repair limit reached)

duplicate_open_prs.title: Multiple open PRs for the same task

base_sync_conflict_unresolved.title: Could not resolve a conflict while syncing base before PR creation

auto_pr_draft_unknown.title: Draft PR created — verification verdict unknown
